systems.system: electronic data exchange between the Ministry of Justice and the DGSN
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and General Directorate of National Security (DGSN), under a memorandum of understanding signed in Rabat on 24 July 2024
systems.tiers: The DGSN is to obtain updated data from the ministry's information systems for managing judicial affairs; the memorandum sets the rules, channels and security standards for the exchange

note: A link between the police and the justice ministry's case systems is the exchange class, logged for dpi.mis--justice. The article says what the DGSN will receive and names no police records system and nothing a station enters.
